trusted_assumptions: core::intrinsics::assert_inhabited::<T> has no runtime result and does not unwind.
MaybeUninit::<T>::as_ptr returns a certified data pointer without unwinding.
axiom_maybe_uninit_points_to links that private representation pointer to shared PointsTo<T> contents equal to m.mem_contents().
vstd::raw_ptr::ptr_ref returns the initialized value represented by its PointsTo permission.
rationale: The source flow is preserved; ptr_ref faithfully desugars Verus's unsupported raw-pointer dereference. The only additional trust is a private-representation bridge plus smaller pointer/intrinsic contracts.
